maple-river-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 9 Maple River Grain locations, 5 in North Dakota and 4 in Minnesota. On the North Dakota side that takes in towns like Casselton, Mapleton and Valley City, and over in Minnesota it runs through Dilworth, Moorhead and Sabin. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat.

mercer-landmark.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 14 Mercer Landmark locations, all of them in Ohio. Towns on the list include Antwerp, Celina, Convoy, Elgin, Fort Recovery and Grover Hill. The table carries bids for corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

michigan-agricultural-commodities.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 7 Michigan Agricultural Commodities locations, all 7 in Michigan. Towns on the list include Blissfield, Breckenridge, Brown City, Jasper, Marlette and Middleton. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat bids for each one.

mid-iowa-cooperative.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 30 Mid-Iowa Cooperative locations, all of them in Iowa. The towns run from Beaman, Buckeye and Conrad out to Cedar Falls, Cedar Rapids and Des Moines. The table carries corn and soybeans at each spot.

minn-kota-ag-products.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 6 Minn-Kota Ag Products locations in 2 states, with 4 in North Dakota and 2 in Minnesota. On the North Dakota side the bids come from towns like Colfax, Mooreton, Wahpeton and Wyndmere, and across the river they come from Breckenridge and Kent. The table carries corn, soybeans and wheat at each spot.

minnesota-valley-grain.story: As of Oct 17, this page lists 3 Minnesota Valley Grain locations, all in Minnesota. The elevators sit at Le Center, Montgomery and Webster. The table carries corn and soybeans at each one, and that is the whole list.
